title: Interview. Ex-Goldman Sachs Matt Reustle on Bad Investor Practices, Sell-side Gripes, and Learning from 200+ Business Breakdowns

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In this fun and insightful conversation we talk to Matt Reustle .
reader_summary.overview: In this fun and insightful conversation we talk to Matt Reustle . Matt was a credit analyst and then equity analyst at Goldman Sachs in New York. He later worked on the buy-side and then moved to become Colossus's CEO.

key_points.text: He later worked on the buy-side and then moved to become Colossus's CEO.
We talk about what people misunderstand about the Sell-side, why most investors fail with management meetings, what he learned from 200+ business breakdowns.
